risk_note: RV2 (settlement / orders: orders.reason_sub, display only). D10-818 ② / D10-862 / D10-867; 08 BR-TEXT-05 「子原因 reason_sub」 写入来源 ①. reason_sub is written only by settlement, in the same statement as reason (pre-credit void in rebate.ts, R8 clawback in clawback-order.ts); a later PUNISH record on a terminal PUNISH order may refine PUNISH_ORDER / null to a more specific PUNISH sub (rights-command.ts), also on the duplicate path (Codex r1 S1), touching only reason_sub. reason_sub_manual = true is never overwritten; a sub always belongs to the current parent reason (a RIGHTS or after-settle record never overwrites a PUNISH sub). Taobao violation_type is matched verbatim against specs/reason-sub-map/taobao.csv (11 PUNISH desc + 订单虚假交易 → FAKE_TRADE; loader rejects non-PUNISH subs, unknown codes, PUNISH_ORDER, duplicates, wrong header); unmatched (incl. coded values and null) → PUNISH_ORDER + warn alert order_reason_sub_unmapped with platform and raw value only (no order / rights number / amount / user). Taobao rights → AFTER_SALE; Taobao order-sync REFUND: before receipt IN_SALE, after settlement AFTER_SETTLE, received-not-settled null. JD and PDD never written. The raw violation text travels to settlement through the rights writer's third argument (RightsSyncExtras), the write item keeps the six fields frozen [AC-B1-04zza] pins; no column added. Amounts, parent reason, state transitions and ledger entries unchanged.
